_note: Concept preview range. Every garment is a SAMPLE: names, colours, sizes and the sampleBase figures are illustrative and feed the sample pricing formula only. Real garments, brands and prices come from the client.

categories.title: Polos & tees
categories.blurb: Everyday workwear tops: polos, t-shirts and sweatshirts, embroidered or printed.

categories.title: Hoodies & fleece
categories.blurb: Hoodies, zip hoodies and fleeces for teams, clubs, leavers and site.

categories.title: Jackets & hi-vis
categories.blurb: Softshells and hi-vis vests with the logo on the chest and the company name across the back.

categories.title: Caps & beanies
categories.blurb: Embroidered caps and beanies: small, front and centre.

categories.title: Aprons
categories.blurb: Bib and waist aprons for kitchens, bars, salons and markets.

garments.title: Classic polo
garments.blurb: The workwear staple. Piqué cotton blend, ribbed collar, three buttons.
garments.details: Unisex fit, sizes XS to 5XL. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Takes embroidery and print. Left chest logo with a name or role on the right chest is the usual trade set-up.

garments.title: Long sleeve polo
garments.blurb: Same polo, longer sleeves, for winter sites and front-of-house.
garments.details: Unisex fit, sizes S to 4XL. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Sleeve position is the forearm, not the cuff.

garments.title: Heavy cotton t-shirt
garments.blurb: A heavyweight tee that holds a big back print and a small chest logo.
garments.details: Unisex fit, sizes XS to 5XL, also in kids' sizes. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Our first choice for printed event and crew tees.

garments.title: Crew sweatshirt
garments.blurb: Brushed-back crew neck. Smart enough for the office, warm enough for the yard.
garments.details: Unisex fit, sizes XS to 4XL. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Embroiders cleanly; large back prints work on the flat back panel.

garments.title: Pullover hoodie
garments.blurb: Kangaroo pocket, double-fabric hood. The club and leavers' favourite.
garments.details: Unisex fit, sizes XS to 4XL, kids 3 to 13. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Names on the back, year on the sleeve, crest on the chest.

garments.title: Zip hoodie
garments.blurb: Full zip, two pockets, a flat left chest for the logo.
garments.details: Unisex fit, sizes XS to 4XL. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Back print clears the zip; chest logos sit left or right of it.

garments.title: Micro fleece
garments.blurb: Full-zip anti-pill fleece. Embroidery only; print does not sit well on pile.
garments.details: Unisex fit, sizes XS to 4XL. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Embroidery with a tear-away topping so the stitches stand proud of the pile.

garments.title: Softshell jacket
garments.blurb: Showerproof, windproof, three zipped pockets. Van-to-site every day.
garments.details: Unisex fit, sizes XS to 4XL. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Embroidery on the chest; back print or embroidery across the shoulders.

garments.title: Hi-vis waistcoat
garments.blurb: Class 2 waistcoat, two bands, printed with your name on the back.
garments.details: Sizes S to 4XL. [STANDARD, e.g. EN ISO 20471 class 2, to confirm]. Print only; embroidery would break the reflective tape line. Back text between the bands.

garments.title: Six panel cap
garments.blurb: Structured cotton cap with a buckle strap. Front embroidery, side detail.
garments.details: One size, adjustable. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Embroidery only. Front panel takes a logo up to 12 cm; the side takes a small mark or initials.

garments.title: Cuffed beanie
garments.blurb: Soft-touch acrylic beanie, logo embroidered on the cuff.
garments.details: One size. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Embroidery on the turned-up cuff, front and centre.

garments.title: Bib apron
garments.blurb: Full-length bib apron with a pocket and adjustable neck strap.
garments.details: One size, 86 cm long. [FABRIC COMPOSITION]. Embroidery or print on the bib; a small mark on the hem corner is a nice second position.
